answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Thesis in a university repository. It requires a thesis archived under one name for years, so the relic of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Honest agents already carry what Thesis in a university repository asks for, so they pass without noticing; the plume is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm doing the maths finds the mesa first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
